operations.description: Simulates the submission of an [ACH Transfer](#ach-transfers) to the Federal Reserve. This transfer must first have a `status` of `pending_approval` or `pending_submission`. In production, Increase submits ACH Transfers to the Federal Reserve three times per day on weekdays. Since sandbox ACH Transfers are not submitted to the Federal Reserve, this endpoint allows you to skip that delay and transition the ACH Transfer to a status of `submitted`.
